content:
Apple One bundles several popular Apple services at a discount, and in iOS 27, the top-tier Premier plan is getting even more perks.

Apple One Premier is getting two upgrades in iOS 27, and they both relate to Apple Intelligence

If you're an Apple One user looking for another reason to upgrade to Apple One Premier, iOS 27 might just be it.

The new iPhone software brings two upgrades for the top Apple One tier.

  • Apple Home AI features
  • Higher image generation limits and more

Apple's Home app is getting a suite of AI features in iOS 27, some of which will be locked behind a 2TB iCloud+ subscription. That means you'll need Apple One Premier, or the topmost standalone iCloud+ plan, to access them.

It's still unclear whether all or only some of the AI features will require a subscription. The iOS 27 beta notes simply state: "Home Apple Intelligence requires iCloud+ subscription starting at 2TB."

Chances are, however, that at least the HomeKit Secure Video upgrades will demand the top plan, including auto-generated video descriptions, clip search, and automatic highlight reel assembly.

If you need a camera that supports HomeKit Secure Video, I'd recommend:

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: An affordable option at just $35
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: Supports 4K recording, but costs more at $59

Beyond Home, some of iOS 27's other new AI features, like image generation, come with daily usage caps. Apple says Apple One Premier subscribers will get higher limits:

Apple One's Individual tier doesn't include a qualifying iCloud+ plan. So if you want higher AI usage limits, that's yet another reason to pick Apple One Premier.

Apple One starts at $19.95 per month and bundles services like Apple TV, Apple Music, and iCloud+.
